title: Topology and electronic character in fused hydrocarbons
difficulty_reasons: Determine a defensible description of electronic character and relevant low-energy states for these topologies.
Choose comparisons that distinguish topology and substitution effects without comparing unequal-composition total energies.
Decide how to establish the stability and uncertainty of the resulting electronic explanation.

data.description: Chemical identity, declared observations and physical boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research records, quantitative findings and artifact links.
